title: Design of lightweight Ti3Zr1.5NbVx refractory high-entropy alloys with superior mechanical properties
process_description: prepared by nonconsumable vacuum arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible under a Ti-gettered argon atmosphere, repeatedly melted at least eight times with flipping after each melting, and maintained a liquid state for a total time of more than 40 min
